name: Shoichi Arai
source:
“You’re so gullible and naive, these seniors here are going to eat you alive.”

An underachieving student who spends most of his classes asleep. Despite his quiet classroom manner, Shoichi boldly begins to pursue Misao when away from the prying eyes of his classmates.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=37532]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
